title: probebehavior-paper: analysis code for water maze probe tests aligned on the first arrival at the empty goal
description: Scripts that reproduce the analyses, figures and supplementary tables of the article 'What rats do when the platform is not there: water maze probe tests aligned on the first arrival at the empty goal' from the archived trajectories, with the analysis plans and their SHA-256 hashes. Uses the Python package probebehavior 0.1.0 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23888805) and the data at doi:10.5281/zenodo.23898439.
